content.name: Protection from Evil and Good

m.text: holy water or powdered silver and iron, which the spell consumes

entries: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.

The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can't be {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, or possessed by them. If the target is already {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, or possessed by such a creature, the target has advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.

content.name: Protection from Evil and Good

m.text: a flask of Holy Water worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against creatures that are Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on attack rolls against the target. The target also can't be possessed by or gain the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} or {@condition Frightened|SRD52} conditions from them. If the target is already possessed, {@condition Charmed|SRD52}, or {@condition Frightened|SRD52} by such a creature, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.
